info.title: Traceable ESG Reporting & Carbon Calculator Platform API
info.description: REST API suite for multi-stakeholder ESG data collection, evidence-backed review workflows, carbon inventory integration, and tamper-evident report generation.

tags.name: Carbon Calculator Integration
tags.description: Endpoints for retrieving and referencing GHG emissions inventory records and emission factors

tags.name: ESG Dashboard
tags.description: Endpoints for retrieving organizational ESG summaries, review completeness, and supplier disclosures

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Endpoints for user login, JWT tokens, and identity management

tags.name: Supporting Evidence
tags.description: Endpoints for uploading, managing, and downloading verified ESG supporting documents

tags.name: ESG Metrics & Workflow
tags.description: Endpoints for entering metrics, calculating values, submitting revisions, and approving submissions

tags.name: Organizations & Periods
tags.description: Endpoints for managing organizations, reporting boundaries, periods, and supply chain links

tags.name: ESG Reports & Immutability
tags.description: Endpoints for generating immutable ESG disclosure reports, viewing historical versions, and downloading PDF/Word files
